intro.title: 9 Mukhi Rudraksha Bracelets
intro.descriptionHtml: Assorted collection of bracelets made of original 9 mukhi Rudraksha beads from Java, stylishly strung in silver, silk thread or stretch elastic. We are one of the oldest and trusted global Rudraksha organizations who supply authentic and finest Rudraksha beads. Each of our bracelet have been stung as per our well-researched unique stringing method of wearing Rudraksha in line with Vedic scriptures and spiritual wisdom to tap the optimum benefits of the Rudraksha. 9 mukhi Rudraksha is governed by Divine mother Durga and is associated with the Crown Chakra. It bestows the wearer with courage, dynamism, fearlessness, name, fame and victory over competitors and enemies.
